content: It has a lot of promise but it really does not do anything special [MARCA] and it has some gaps. For instance the budgets for each month dont tie together. Once you role over it will tell you you have x available to budget, and not remove the credit card bill from last months spending from that number. And it's web forecasting abilities (not in app yet) don't add each month to the last, instead just showing the savings for each individual month.

I'm disappointed

Look, I was sad to lose the insights from [MARCA], which I had for free, so much so I was willing to pay a little to get them back, but your app is absolute trash, and I can't justify $10 for it annually, let alone $99, so I've canceled my subscription not even one day into the free trial. This app is unintuitive, uninspired, and the team approving this kind of software out into production does not inspire me. [APP] seems like a real loser to me.

The app is fine but the connectors are very flaky. More damaging is the support is totally inadequate. The human agents are clearly overwhelmed by ticket volume and just close and mark as 'solved'. The AI agent that auto resolves is even more insulting and time wasting.
